plan.coverage_explanation: Tests default temperature display, repeated button toggles, stable display mode during a sustained button hold, live temperature and humidity updates, the 30°C boundary, fan activation above the threshold in both display modes, and cooling back to off. No strict comparison between two hot-state PWM values is imposed: unspecified quantization and saturation could legitimately make them equal. Temperature-dependent speed adjustment remains a coverage gap because the available check schema cannot independently enforce it without prescribing an unsupported speed mapping.
assumptions: Uses the bench default button wiring: D2 is connected to GND when pressed, uses INPUT_PULLUP, and is HIGH when released.
Fan PWM on D5 is active HIGH, with the fan off at or below 30°C.
TM1637 numeric displays may use leading blanks or zeros.
Button switching may occur on either press or release. During a settled sustained hold, the display mode must remain stable; completed-press checks require the toggled mode.
No exact response period or debounce interval is specified. Sensor states persist for four seconds, with sensor-update checks allowing at least 2.5 seconds to settle.
No PWM slope, quantization, or saturation temperature is specified. Hot-state checks require nonzero PWM but do not prescribe relative duties.
The reference chooses a linear PWM ramp saturating at 50°C as a permitted implementation, not a candidate requirement. Invalid sensor-reading behavior is unspecified and untested.
